claims.content: The customer registers a new free JTVauctions.com account.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The customer registers a new free JTVauctions.com account.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: A customer registers a new free JTVauctions.com account on the JTV Auctions website.
scope_contract.start_boundary: Customer begins registration for a new JTVauctions.com account.
scope_contract.success_boundary: A new free JTVauctions.com customer account has been registered.
in_scope_actions: register a new free JTVauctions.com account
complete the customer account registration process
excluded_adjacent_actions: accessing or managing preferred payment types after registration
variant_dimensions: none specified in the cited goal evidence for the canonical successful instance

claims.content: Customer
The system has a Consumer Protection negative file available to cross-reference against new customer data before account creation can proceed.

The use case is triggered when a NEW customer starts creating a new JTVauctions.com account by clicking the 'Register Now' link in the website's top navigation bar or global footer and then entering the minimum required information on the first page of the two-page registration flow.

Customer enters the required identity and account credentials on Registration Page 1: First Name, Last Name, E-mail Address (entered twice), Password (8-12 characters, entered twice), and a unique Member ID ("Handle").
Customer selects a default payment method by choosing Credit Card, PayPal, or Amazon Payments.
Customer checks the Terms of Use Agreement checkbox located beneath the Payment Methods section; the Finish Now button remains grayed out until this checkbox is checked.
Customer clicks Finish Now to submit the minimum required information and complete the short registration process.
System advances the customer to Registration Page 2, titled "Continuing Your Membership Creation".
System pre-populates the My Information Section First Name and Last Name fields on Registration Page 2 from the data provided on Registration Page 1; the phone number is not pre-populated.
Customer provides additional shipping-order information on Registration Page 2, including billing/shipping addresses and shipping preferences.

Customer selects email notification preferences by checking the desired checkboxes on Registration Page 2: notify when outbid, notify when an auction is won, and notify when a winning bid is processed.
System displays a modal dialog instructing the customer to add shop@jewelrtv.rsvs1.com to their email program's address book or safe senders list and to enable cookies in the browser.

Upon completion of registration, the system sends an automated transactional email with a Welcome and Thank You message using the customer's real name, stating "You are now registered with JTV Auctions!", and including instructions to enable cookies and whitelist the sender address.
Diverges from Step 2: If the customer selects PayPal as the default payment method, they are directed to sign up for a free account at www.PayPal.com via the link provided in the registration form.

Diverges from Step 2: If the customer already has a PayPal or Amazon Payments account, they may use that existing account during registration instead of creating a new external account; if the customer has previously purchased from Amazon, the system informs them that they already have an Amazon Payments account.

Diverges from Step 4: After completing the minimum required information on Registration Page 1, the customer may choose the 'I Want to Sign in Now!' button instead of continuing to Registration Page 2. This action takes the user to the sign-in page and defers completion of additional registration information until later.

Diverges from Step 7: Instead of manually entering the shipping address, the customer selects the 'Same as Billing Address' checkbox, and the system copies the billing address details into the shipping address fields.

Diverges from Step 8: The customer may click the link labeled 'Change my "Auction Insider" Email Newsletter Subscription' to opt out of the Auction Insider email newsletter subscription while completing the email notification preferences.

missing_aspects: The claim includes unsupported detail about 'instead of using an existing external account'. The cited cards only state that the user is directed to sign up if they select PayPal; they do not describe the system's behavior regarding users who already have accounts (i.e., whether they can skip this step or how).

The claim refers to a 'browse now' button, but the cited evidence (EC-AF-021) describes it as such while EC-AF-003 and EC-AF-022 explicitly label the button 'I Want to Sign in Now!'. To be precise based on the visual/textual evidence, the primary label should be used.

claims.content: At main_flow Step 4, if a NEW customer attempting to create a new JTVauctions.com account matches the Consumer Protection negative file (indicating previous accounts closed by us), the system prevents account creation and displays the message: 'We are sorry, we are unable to create an auction account for you at this time. If you believe this message to be in error, please contact our Customer Service team at: 800-550-8393.'

At main_flow Step 4, if the registrant submits an email address that is already in use, the system notifies the registrant that the email address is already in use and asks whether they need to reset it; the email address must be unique in the customer table.

At main_flow Step 4, if the Member ID ('Handle') entered is a duplicate of an existing Handle in the customer table, the system identifies this as an error condition that must be resolved before registration can proceed; the Handle is required and must be unique.

At main_flow Step 4, if the customer attempts to click the 'Finish Now' button before checking the Terms of Use Agreement checkbox, the system displays a popup stating that the customer must read and agree to the Terms of Use before proceeding; the Finish Now button remains grayed out until the checkbox is checked.

At main_flow Step 7, if the combination of first name, last name, and street address matches an existing account, the system informs the customer that an account already exists and offers to send sign-in information to the email address on file.

missing_aspects: Exact continuation after duplicate-email notification (whether the registrant may enter a different email or complete a password reset within this use case) is not documented.
Exact continuation after duplicate-account notification (whether accepting the sign-in-information offer transfers to a separate sign-in use case) is not documented.
Exact correction/navigation step after duplicate Handle error is not documented.
EC-EF-018 documents a Browse Now terms-validation block, but no main_flow step covers Browse Now; main_flow may need extension to place this exception.

claims.content: A new JTV Auctions customer account has been successfully registered; the customer is now registered with JTV Auctions.

The system sends an automated transactional email to the customer's registered email address containing a Welcome and Thank You message using the customer's real name, stating "You are now registered with JTV Auctions!", and including instructions to enable cookies and whitelist the sender address (shop@jewelrtv.rsvs1.com).
The system displays a modal dialog (pop-up) instructing the customer to add shop@jewelrtv.rsvs1.com to their email program's address book or safe senders list and to enable cookies in the browser.
Upon successful completion of Registration Page 1 by clicking 'Finish Now', the system advances the customer to Registration Page 2 titled 'Continuing Your Membership Creation'.

inconsistency_hints: The main flow follows the Finish Now path after Registration Page 1 and never includes the 'I Want to Sign in Now!' choice or its resulting immediate sign-in behavior. As a result, the main flow cannot lead to postcondition 4, which is conditional on choosing Sign in Now instead of Finish Now.
